summary: Comprehensive product requirements document for an MCP Security Posture Scanner — a deterministic, enumerate-only security scanner for MCP servers. Defines scope boundaries, build phases, rule set, data model, API contract, repository structure, rubric mapping, tech stack, open items, non-goals, and an operator-requested decision model extension. Serves as single source of truth for the project.
key_indicators: Section 0 explicitly positions itself as 'single source of truth'
Defines hard scope boundaries (deterministic engine, enumerate-only, clean-room)
Phased build plan (Phase 0-5) with dependency ordering
Rubric-to-deliverable mapping table defining 'done' per category
Functional spec with data model, API endpoints, and fixed rule set
Repository structure requirements down to file level
Open items section lists unresolved questions for human operator
